school: 孔门弟子中'行不由径'的取径纪律与'设取予去就'的制度化德行传统：以两条具体的路（大路、公事之路）回答'你是什么人'，以被误判后'退而修行、南游至江'完成对误判的时间对冲，以'贵之不喜，贱之不怒'守住情绪水位——把老师学问中最可执行的行为规范重新制度化给三百南方弟子，以'以自遂'收束一生
historical_significance: 澹台灭明（字子羽，少孔子三十九岁），鲁国南武城人，《史记》记其'状貌甚恶'，孔子初见'以为材薄'——圣门最著名的看走眼；他在武城为子游属吏，以'行不由径，非公事未尝至于偃之室'两句话被举为得人范例；受业完成后'退而修行'，南游至长江流域，'从弟子三百人，设取予去就，名施乎诸侯'——把儒学带入吴楚之间，建立起同辈弟子中最大规模的地方师门；《大戴礼记》载孔子晚年定评'贵之，不喜；贱之，不怒；苟于民利矣，廉于其事上也，以自遂也'，并以'以言取人，失之宰予；以貌取人，失之子羽'自省——他是孔门中把'为己之学'走完一生的最完整案例：受业为己、修行为己、设规为己、传灯为己，名，是别人的事；后世江南文教传统多追认澹台南游为吴地儒学之先声，'澹台湖'等地名犹存其迹
historical_significance_en: Zantai Mieming (courtesy name Ziyu, thirty-nine years younger than Confucius), a man of southern Wucheng in Lu, is recorded by the Shiji as of forbidding countenance — Confucius at first meeting judged him 'of slight ability,' the school's most famous misreading; serving under Ziyou at Wucheng he was cited as a model find on the strength of two sentences: 'he never takes the shortcut, and never comes save on official business'; after taking his degree he 'withdrew and cultivated,' traveled south to the Yangtze basin, where 'three hundred disciples followed him; he set rules of taking, giving, going and staying; his name reached the lords' — carrying Confucian learning among Wu and Chu and building the largest regional school among his peers; the Da Dai Liji preserves the master's late verdict: 'raised, he shows no delight; slighted, he shows no anger; if it profits the people, even in serving superiors he keeps incorrupt, so to complete his own way' — with the self-reproach 'judging by speech, I lost Zai Yu; judging by looks, I lost Ziyu'; he is the school's most complete case of learning 'for oneself' lived to the end: schooled for himself, cultivated for himself, rules set for himself, the lamp passed for himself — fame, that was other people's business; the later literary traditions of the south trace their Confucian dawn to his journey, and the Zantai Lake still bears his name
unique_thinking: 澹台灭明思维模式的独特性在于四条主线的合成：第一，'路径即人格'——他不谈抽象的德，只给两条可被旁人看见的路（不走小径、非公事不登私室），把道德从内心审查变成可验证的行为文件；第二，'时间对冲误判'——面对孔子的'以为材薄'，他不用辩解争夺裁判权，而是退到误判覆盖不到的南方，用可积累的资产（三百弟子、行为规程、诸侯名声）让旧判决在时间面前自动失效；第三，'先规后事'——'设取予去就'表明他的德行是制度化的：四道关口（取、予、去、就）在诱惑到场之前已立法，遇事只执行不挣扎；第四，'情绪恒温'——'贵之不喜，贱之不怒'：把贵贱统一处理为别人的报价，报价不设定体温；这四条线共同收束于'以自遂'——人生的验收标准不是别人是否收回误判，而是自己是否走完了自己的路
unique_thinking_en: The distinctiveness of Zantai Mieming's thinking is a synthesis of four lines. First, the path as person: he speaks no abstract virtue but gives two roads visible to any bystander — never the footpath, never the governor's room save on business — turning morality from inward audit into a verifiable document of conduct. Second, hedging misjudgment with time: against Confucius' 'slight ability' he did not contest the judgeship with argument, but withdrew south beyond the verdict's reach and answered with accumulable assets — three hundred disciples, a code of conduct, a name reaching the lords — letting the old verdict expire of itself before time. Third, rules before events: 'he set rules of taking, giving, going, staying' — his virtue institutionalized; the four gates legislated before temptation arrives, so that at the event one only executes and does not struggle. Fourth, constant temperature: 'raised, no delight; slighted, no anger' — noble and base processed alike as other people's quotations, and quotations do not set one's temperature. All four lines close on 'completing his own way': the acceptance standard of a life is not whether others retract their misjudgment, but whether one finished one's own road
civilization_zh: 春秋末期的鲁国武城与江东——孔门第二代向外传学的时代：子游在武城以弦歌为治、举荐'行不由径'的属吏；被夫子'以貌取人'看走眼的澹台灭明退而修行，南游至江，在儒学尚属远郊的吴楚之间立起三百弟子的师门，把'取予去就'的规矩立成长江之畔的行为标准——一个状貌甚恶的鲁国南武城人，用不抄近路的一生，让'失之子羽'成为老师最著名的自省
civilization_en: Wucheng in Lu and the lands of the lower Yangtze at the close of the Spring and Autumn period — the age when the second generation of Confucius' school carried the learning outward: Ziyou governing Wucheng with strings and song, recommending the subordinate who 'never took the shortcut'; Zantai Mieming, the man misjudged for his looks, withdrew and cultivated, traveled south to the river, and among Wu and Chu — then the far province of Confucian learning — raised a school of three hundred disciples, setting the code of taking, giving, going and staying as a standard of conduct on the banks of the Yangtze — a man of forbidding countenance from southern Lu who, by a life without shortcuts, made 'I lost Ziyu' his teacher's most famous self-reproach

cross_references.description_zh: 孔子与澹台灭明是师徒关系中最著名的'误判-反转'案例：孔子以'状貌甚恶'判其材薄，又以'以言取人失之宰予，以貌取人失之子羽'自省——圣人亲自示范了识人的两种系统性偏差（言与貌）及其修正；澹台灭明则以受业不怨、退而修行回答了'被老师看走眼怎么办'——一方提供了误判的样本与自省的范式，一方提供了被误判者的最优响应；师徒二人共同构成了先秦'识人与被识'的完整教学案例。
cross_references.description_en: Confucius and Zantai Mieming form the most famous misjudgment-and-reversal case in the teacher-student record: the master judged him 'of slight ability' by his looks and then corrected himself — 'judging by speech, I lost Zai Yu; judging by looks, I lost Ziyu' — the sage personally demonstrating the two systematic biases of reading men, speech and face, and their amendment; Zantai answered 'what to do when your teacher misreads you' by taking his degree without resentment, withdrawing and cultivating; one side supplied the specimen of misjudgment and the paradigm of self-correction, the other the optimal response of the misjudged; together teacher and student compose the complete early-Chinese case study of judging and being judged.

cross_references.description_zh: 子游与澹台灭明是'识人于小节'的一对见证者与被见证者：子游治武城以弦歌，问属吏行事而得'行不由径，非公事不至偃室'之答——他是史上第一位从'两条路'里认出人才的长官；澹台灭明则是第一个把'小路上的表现'当作人格文件提交的人；孔门重'观过知仁'，两人把这一认识论落实为可操作的人事实践：长官看小路，属吏走大路——一次问答完成双向验证。
cross_references.description_en: Ziyou and Zantai Mieming are the witness and the witnessed of 'reading men in small ways': Ziyou governed Wucheng with strings and song, asked his subordinate how he conducted himself, and drew the answer 'never the shortcut, never save on official business' — the first governor on record to recognize talent from 'two roads'; Zantai was the first to submit the conduct of small paths as a document of character; the school held 'from a man's faults you may know his virtue,' and the two made that epistemology operational practice: the governor watches the small road, the subordinate walks the great one — one question and answer completing a two-way verification.

cross_references.description_zh: 澹台灭明与荀子同属儒家'制度化'路线的两端：荀子以'礼义非人格化'把德行转化为客观规范——以程式化约束替代个人品德依赖；澹台灭明以'设取予去就'把德行写成门人可执行的规程——把取、予、去、就四道关口预先立法；两人都拒绝把儒学停留在'圣贤临场表现'层面：一个向帝国输出制度，一个向三百弟子输出规程；先秦儒学'从德目到制度'的转化，在他们手中各完成一半。
cross_references.description_en: Zantai Mieming and Xunzi stand at two ends of Confucianism's 'institutional' line: Xunzi turned virtue into objective norms by the 'de-personalization of ritual and rightness' — programmatic constraint replacing reliance on personal character; Zantai wrote virtue into a code his disciples could execute — the four gates of taking, giving, going and staying legislated in advance; both refused to leave Confucianism at the level of the sage's live performance: one exported institutions to an empire, one exported rules to three hundred disciples; between them they each completed half of the school's transformation from virtue-items to institution.

cross_references.description_zh: 澹台灭明与董仲舒是儒学'南传/制度生根'的两端：董仲舒以天人三策把儒学立为汉代官学——由上而下的制度化；澹台灭明以'设取予去就'把儒学带进吴楚民间师门——由下而上的制度化；两人都相信儒学的生命力在'可执行的规程'而非'高悬的概念'：一个为朝廷立规范，一个为三百弟子立规矩；相隔四百年，共同证明同一命题：儒学每次扩张，都以把德行写成可操作文本为前提。
cross_references.description_en: Zantai Mieming and Dong Zhongshu are the two poles of Confucianism's spread and institutional rooting: Dong Zhongshu raised the learning to state doctrine of Han by the three memorial on heaven and man — institutionalization from above; Zantai carried it among the people of Wu and Chu, setting the code of taking, giving, going, staying for a school of three hundred — institutionalization from below; both believed the learning's vitality lay in executable rules, not suspended concepts: one wrote norms for a court, one rules for disciples; four centuries apart they prove one proposition — every expansion of Confucianism has been premised on writing virtue into an operational text.

modes.name_en: The Method of Never Taking the Shortcut
modes.domain_zh: 澹台灭明在武城做子游的属下时，子游问其行事，他给出的自我介绍只有一件事：'行不由径，非公事未尝至于偃之室也'——走路从不抄小路，不是公务从不到长官私室——一句话把取径纪律与公私边界同时立起来；从澹台到武城，大路明明更远，小径明明更近，他坚持走大路；从武城到长官的屋子，顺路拜访明明能拉近关系，他坚持非公事不登门；这不是迂腐，是一种把'路径本身'当作人格文件的活法：你抄的每一次近道，都在向世界申报'目的可以压倒程序'；他证明：品格不在大节上被检验——大节人人会演——而在小路上被检验：无人监督处怎么走，才是真路径；他一生行走于'由径'与'不由径'的分界上，把每一步都走成了证词
modes.domain_en: When Zantai Mieming served under Ziyou at Wucheng, Ziyou asked how he conducted himself, and the whole self-report came to one sentence: 'He never takes the shortcut, and never comes to my room except on official business' — path discipline and the boundary of public and private erected in a single line; from Dantai to Wucheng the high road was plainly longer, the footpath plainly shorter, and he kept to the high road; from Wucheng to the governor's room a courtesy call would plainly have drawn them closer, and he kept to official business only; this is not pedantry but a way of living that treats the path itself as a document of character: every shortcut you take files a declaration with the world that ends may override procedure; he proved: character is not tested on great occasions — on great occasions everyone performs — but on small paths: how you walk where no one watches is your true path; his whole life moved along the border of 'by the path' and 'not by the path,' and each step became testimony
modes.source_chapter: 《论语·雍也》：子游为武城宰，曰'子为司寇，得人为急，得澹台灭明'；子游问'女得人焉尔乎'，答曰'有澹台灭明者，行不由径，非公事未尝至于偃之室也'——《史记·仲尼弟子列传》载其'状貌甚恶'，孔子'以为材薄'，后南游至江，'从弟子三百人，设取予去就，名施乎诸侯'；'行不由径'与'非公事不至偃室'为澹台灭明在传世文献中最具体的两则行事记录，前者关于取径，后者关于公私，共同构成其人格的最小完备刻画；'径'字在先秦文献中指田间小路、非正道之路，'不由径'由此成为德行的具体可验证指标——它不需要内心审查，只需要旁人看路
modes.key_quote_zh: 行不由径，非公事未尝至于偃之室也——品格不在大节上被检验，而在小路上被检验
modes.key_quote_en: "He never takes the shortcut, never comes save on official business — character is tested not on great occasions but on small paths."
process_zh: 盘点你的'径'：列出你工作中所有'更近但不在正道上'的路径——走关系绕流程、借名头办事、用灰色信息抢跑——每一条都是可以被旁人看见的'抄近道'
把'不由径'变成可验证指标而非自我评价：不问'我心里正不正'，问'我的路径别人能否复述'——一条能被旁人看懂并指认的路，才是干净的路
给公私之间立一道硬墙：凡借职务积累私谊、借私谊推进公务的通道逐一封死——'非公事不至长官之室'墙内的空间小了，人格的空间就大了
接受大路的成本并把它计入预算：正道比捷径远、比捷径慢，把这部分多出来的成本当作'人格折旧费'预先支付——预算里没有这笔钱的人，迟早去抄近道
process_en: Inventory your footpaths: list every 'shorter but off the proper road' route in your work — threading connections around process, borrowing titles, racing ahead on gray information; each is a shortcut visible to others
Turn 'no shortcut' from self-appraisal into a verifiable metric: ask not 'am I upright at heart' but 'can another retrace my route' — a road others can read and point to is a clean road

Erect a hard wall between public and private: seal every channel that converts office into friendship or friendship into office; the room beyond 'never save on official business' shrinks, and the room of character grows

Budget the cost of the high road: the proper road is longer and slower; prepay the difference as a depreciation charge on character — whoever leaves it unbudgeted will sooner or later take the footpath
representative_cases_zh: 武城自述：子游问其行事，答以'行不由径，非公事未尝至于偃之室'——用两条具体的路回答'你是什么人'，被孔子后期列为得人范例
子游得人：《论语》以澹台灭明作为'识人于小节'的标准案例——子在武城闻弦歌之声而'割鸡焉用牛刀'的语境里，子游举出的人恰恰是最不显山露水的一个
南游三百徒：被老师低估的人后来'从弟子三百人，设取予去就，名施乎诸侯'——大路走了一辈子的人，最终被大路上的同行者承认
representative_cases_en: The self-report at Wucheng: asked how he conducted himself, he answered with two concrete roads — 'never the shortcut, never save on official business' — answering 'what sort of man are you' with the paths he walks, later ranked by Confucius as a model of finding the right man
Ziyou's find: the Analects uses Zantai as the standard case of judging a man by small ways — amid the strings and singing of Wucheng, the man Ziyou named was the least conspicuous of all

Three hundred disciples in the south: the man his teacher underrated later gathered three hundred followers, 'setting rules of taking, giving, going and staying, his name known to the feudal lords' — one who walked the high road all his life was at last acknowledged by those who walked it with him
modern_applications_zh: 把'合规路径'写进流程而非口头：公司规定'审批走系统不走微信''供应商引入必须三方比价'——把'行不由径'从个人美德变成组织的基础设施，让抄近道在技术上变难
以'路径可复述'为尽调指标：考察合作方时问'你们上一个项目是怎么拿到的'——答案里若全是关系与时机而无一程序，径已在脚下
给自己设'公事登记簿'：与上级、客户的每一次非正式接触都留痕记录——不是表演清白，而是让'非公事不至室'可审计；可审计的清白才是硬通货
modern_applications_en: Write path discipline into process, not rhetoric: approvals through the system, never through chat; vendor onboarding always three-bid — turning 'never the shortcut' from private virtue into organizational infrastructure that makes shortcuts technically hard
Use 'retraceable path' as a due-diligence probe: ask a partner 'how did you win your last deal' — an answer all connection and timing and no procedure means the footpath is already underfoot

Keep a public-register of contacts: log every informal touch with superiors and clients — not performing innocence but making 'never save on official business' auditable; auditable integrity is the only hard currency

modes.name_en: The Method of the Misjudged Man's Answer
modes.category: 认知方法/以长期对冲误判
modes.domain_zh: 孔子初见澹台灭明，'状貌甚恶'——长得难看——便'以为材薄'，判定此子成不了器；这是孔圣人一生罕见的看走眼，他自己后来也承认：'以貌取人，失之子羽'（与'以言取人，失之宰予'对举）；而澹台灭明对这个误判的回答堪称全部历史的典范：他不辩解、不怨怼、不远走，而是退到南方，用三百年才够长的时间尺度做一件事——'从弟子三百人，设取予去就，名施乎诸侯'——把三百弟子、把取予去就的规矩、把传到诸侯耳朵里的名声，全部造成对误判的沉默反驳；他证明：对误判最有力量的回应不是当场翻案，而是让判决在时间面前自动失效——你当年给我打的分，由我此后的路来重新批改
modes.domain_en: Confucius, first meeting Zantai Mieming, saw a mean countenance — 'his appearance was unprepossessing' — and judged him 'of slight ability'; it was one of the rare misreadings of the sage's life, and he later confessed it: 'judging by looks, I lost Ziyu' — set beside 'judging by speech, I lost Zai Yu'; and Zantai's answer to that misjudgment is the exemplar of all history: he did not argue, did not resent, did not flee; he withdrew south and set a time-scale of decades to one task — 'three hundred disciples, rules of taking and giving, of going and staying, his name reaching the lords' — building three hundred students, a code of acquisition and refusal, a fame carried to the ears of princes, all into a silent rebuttal of the verdict; he proved: the most powerful answer to misjudgment is not overturning it on the spot but letting it expire of itself before time — the grade you gave me then, my road since re-marks it
modes.source_chapter: 《史记·仲尼弟子列传》：'澹台灭明，字子羽，少孔子三十九岁。状貌甚恶。欲事孔子，孔子以为材薄。既已受业，退而修行，行不由径，非公事不见卿大夫。南游至江，从弟子三百人，设取予去就，名施乎诸侯。孔子闻之，曰：以言取人，失之宰予；以貌取人，失之子羽。'——《论语·雍也》载子游荐其在武城之行事；《大戴礼记·卫将军文子》记孔子历数弟子之行而及澹台灭明'贵之不喜，贱之不怒，苟于民利矣，廉于其事上也，以自遂也'——'贵之不喜，贱之不怒'八字恰是他对'被低估'处境的完整心态写照

modes.key_quote_en: "Judging by looks, I lost Ziyu — the strongest answer to misjudgment is not overturning it on the spot but letting it expire before time."
process_zh: 先冻结'当场翻案'的冲动：被误判的第一反应是辩解与证明——但辩解把裁判权留在误判者手里；把这句话咽下去，改问'我需要谁的承认才能继续'
把'退'变成战略而非逃跑：澹台灭明退到孔子声望未达的南方——不是离开战场，而是换一个误判覆盖不到的市场；退的位置要选在'评价体系之外'而非'世界之外'
用可积累的资产回应：不造舆论、不找公道，只积累不能被收回的东西——弟子、规矩、实绩；误判者的话会随风散，可积累的资产不散
让时间完成批改：不追着旧判决要平反——你走得足够远之后，旧判决会作为'看走眼的著名案例'替你流传；连误判本身都成了你的注脚
process_en: Freeze the urge to overturn on the spot: the first reflex to misjudgment is to argue and prove — but argument leaves judgment in the misjudger's hands; swallow it and ask instead 'whose recognition do I actually need to go on'

Make retreat strategy, not flight: Zantai withdrew south, beyond the reach of Confucius' fame — not leaving the field but changing to a market the misjudgment cannot cover; retreat to where the evaluation system ends, not where the world ends

Answer with accumulable assets: no publicity, no petition for justice — accumulate only what cannot be repossessed: disciples, rules, performed work; the misjudger's words scatter on the wind; accumulable assets do not

Let time do the re-marking: do not chase the old verdict for rehabilitation; once you have gone far enough, the verdict circulates as the famous case of being wrong — even the misjudgment becomes your footnote
representative_cases_zh: '状貌甚恶——以为材薄'：孔子因相貌判其无才，收他做了学生却没当回事——史上最著名的一次'简历初筛失误'
退而修行、南游至江：不在鲁国纠缠'老师为什么不重视我'，直接把人生主战场迁到长江流域——退的是位置，进的是事业
孔子亲口承认'失之子羽'：误判者本人在听到南方的消息后自认看走眼——历史上极少数由误判者亲自撤回的判决
representative_cases_en: A mean countenance, 'slight ability': Confucius judged him talentless by his face, took him in and paid him little mind — history's most famous screening error

Withdraw and cultivate, south to the river: no wrangling in Lu over 'why does my teacher slight me'; the main battlefield of his life moved outright to the Yangtze — position retreated, career advanced
The master's own confession: the misjudger, hearing news from the south, retracted in his own words — one of history's few verdicts withdrawn by the judge himself
modern_applications_zh: '被低估者'的南方策略：在当前组织被判'不行'后，不内耗着求重评，评估哪个更大市场里自己的能力被定价更高——换市场比换观念快
用'可积累资产清单'替代'证明清单'：被质疑时把'我要向谁证明什么'改写为'我三年后手里会有什么别人拿不走的东西'——前者依赖裁判，后者依赖时间
对他人做'子羽条款'：自己给别人打分时，为'相貌/口才/背景偏差'设硬性折价修正——主动承认自己大概率会'失之子羽'，是避免失之的唯一起点
modern_applications_en: The southerner's strategy for the underrated: after being ruled 'not good enough' inside an organization, stop burning energy petitioning for re-review; map which larger market prices your ability higher — changing markets beats changing minds

Replace the proof-list with an asset-list: when doubted, rewrite 'whom must I prove what to' as 'what unconfiscatable things will I hold in three years' — the former depends on judges, the latter on time

A 'Ziyu clause' for scoring others: whenever you grade a person, apply a hard correction for bias of looks, eloquence and background; openly conceding you will probably 'lose a Ziyu' is the only starting point not losing one

modes.name_en: The Method of Rules for Taking, Giving, Going, Staying
modes.domain_zh: 《史记》记澹台灭明南游成就，用的不是'德行高'这类评价词，而是一句制度性描述：'设取予去就'——他为三百弟子'设立'了对待取与予、去与就的规矩；这四个字是儒家伦理中最难也最日常的四道关口：取（接受什么）、予（给予什么）、去（何时离开）、就（何时就任）——多数人凭当下情绪与利益临时拍板，澹台灭明把它们预先立成规矩：什么钱不能拿、什么忙不能帮、什么职位必须辞、什么邀请不能应——先设规矩后遇事，遇事时人只需执行而无需挣扎；他证明：个人品格的最高形态不是'每次都选对'的临场表现，而是一套在诱惑到来之前就已生效的规则系统——把道德从'选择题'变成'执行题'
modes.domain_en: The Shiji records Zantai Mieming's southern achievement not with evaluative words like 'high virtue' but with an institutional sentence: 'he set rules of taking, giving, going and staying' — for three hundred disciples he established the code governing what to accept, what to give, when to leave, when to take office; these four are the hardest and most daily checkpoints of Confucian ethics: accept (what to receive), give (what to bestow), leave (when to go), take (when to assume); most people decide on the spot by mood and interest; Zantai set the rules in advance: what money cannot be touched, what favor cannot be done, what post must be resigned, what invitation must be declined; rules set before events, at the event one only executes and does not struggle; he proved: the highest form of personal character is not the live performance of always choosing right but a system of rules already in force before temptation arrives — turning morality from a choice-question into an execution-question
modes.source_chapter: 《史记·仲尼弟子列传》：'南游至江，从弟子三百人，设取予去就，名施乎诸侯'——'设'字为全句关键：不是'他本人做到'而是'他为门下立规'，显示其成就的重心在制度化而非个人表演；《大戴礼记·卫将军文子》记其'贵之不喜，贱之不怒'、'廉于其事上'——取予去就的具体表现；先秦儒家对'去就'一环尤为看重：孔子'可以仕则仕，可以止则止'、孟子'所就三，去三'均为同一传统；澹台灭明的独特处在于把这一套从圣贤的临场判断下放为门人弟子的日常规程——鲁地儒学的南方传播由此获得可复制性

modes.key_quote_en: "He set rules of taking, giving, going, staying — the highest character is not the live performance of always choosing right but a system of rules in force before temptation arrives."
process_zh: 把'取予去就'四关逐项立法：取——列'永不接受清单'（哪类钱、哪类好处）；予——列'帮助的边界'（帮到哪为止、不卷入什么）；去——列'离场触发条件'（何种情况必须辞）；就——列'就任前置条件'（何种职位必须具备什么才接受）
在平静时立法、在激动时执法：所有规矩都在没有具体诱惑在场时定下——具体的诱惑一到，'要不要破例'的挣扎应该为零，因为立法者三年前已经替你决定
把规矩'设'给团队而非只设给自己：澹台灭明的'设'面向三百弟子——个人洁癖没有传播力，可交接的规程才有；把你的底线写成别人也能执行的手册
定期用真实案例回测规矩：每当自己或弟子在某关上动摇，把该案例带回规矩文本前——改的要么是行为，要么是规矩；两条都改说明规矩从未被当真
process_en: Legislate the four gates one by one: taking — a never-accept list (which money, which favors); giving — the boundary of help (where help stops, what it never enters); leaving — trigger conditions (what obliges resignation); taking office — preconditions (what must be present before a post is accepted)

Legislate in calm, execute in agitation: all rules set while no concrete temptation is in the room; when a specific temptation arrives, the struggle to 'make an exception' should be zero — the legislator decided for you years ago

Set the rules for a team, not only for yourself: Zantai's 'setting' faced three hundred disciples — private fastidiousness does not travel, a transferable code does; write your bottom lines as a manual others can execute

Backtest the code against real cases: whenever you or a disciple waver at a gate, bring the case back to the text; change the behavior or change the rule — changing both means the code was never meant seriously
representative_cases_zh: 三百弟子皆有取予去就之规：史载其南方事业的核心不是个人讲学而是'设'——一个可复制的行为规程在门人中运转
'贵之不喜，贱之不怒'：被抬高不得意、被贬低不动怒——情绪本身也被纳入了'规矩'管辖，不留给临场发挥
与孟子'所就三，去三'的呼应：战国儒家把'去就'正式条款化，而澹台灭明是这一条款化传统最早的开立者之一
representative_cases_en: Three hundred disciples all under the code of taking, giving, going, staying: the core of his southern enterprise was not personal lecturing but 'setting' — a transferable code of conduct running among his people
'Raised, he shows no delight; slighted, no anger': emotion itself brought under the code, nothing left to live improvisation
The echo in Mencius' 'three grounds for taking office, three for leaving': the Warring States Confucians codified going and staying; Zantai was among the earliest to open that codification
modern_applications_zh: 给团队立'四关手册'：入职第一天发'永不接受清单''帮助边界''离场触发条件''就任前置条件'——让新人在第一次诱惑到来之前已读过答案；制度先于考验，考验才有效
把'平静时立法'用于个人理财与职业：设定'利益冲突申报线''跳槽触发条件''拒绝应酬清单'——所有红线都在头脑冷静时划好，饭局上只做执行不做决策
用回测淘汰'假规矩'：年终审计时逐条检查'今年哪条规矩被动摇过'——被动摇却未修改任何一方的，标记为装饰品，下年度要么强化执行要么删除
modern_applications_en: Publish a four-gate handbook for your team: day one, hand out the never-accept list, the boundary of help, the triggers for leaving, the preconditions for taking a post — let newcomers read the answers before the first temptation arrives; institution before test, or the test is void

Legislate calm for money and career: set your conflict-declaration line, your job-change triggers, your list of events to decline — all red lines drawn with a cool head; at the dinner table one only executes, never decides
Backtest away the fake rules: in the annual audit check 'which rule wavered this year'; one that wavered with nothing amended on either side is decoration — next year either enforce it or delete it

modes.name_en: The Method of Neither Elated nor Enraged
modes.domain_zh: 《大戴礼记》记孔子历数弟子品行，说到澹台灭明时用了八个字：'贵之不喜，贱之不怒'——被贵人抬举，不喜形于色；被贱视贬低，不动怒于色——这八个字与他的另一重身份严丝合缝：那个被孔夫子'以为材薄'过的人；被低估过的少年后来既尝过'贱'的滋味，也尝过'贵'的滋味（名施诸侯，诸侯以贵相待），两头的反应却是同一个平静；他证明：情绪对他人评价的依赖程度，就是人格被他人持有的程度——贵与贱都是别人的出价，出价不该设定你的体温；真正自由的人不是不在乎评价，而是让评价流过而不改变水位
modes.domain_en: In the Da Dai Liji, when Confucius reviews the conduct of his disciples, eight characters mark Zantai Mieming: 'raised, he shows no delight; slighted, he shows no anger' — honored by the great, no delight on his face; slighted and disdained, no anger on his face — eight characters that fit his other identity exactly: the young man Confucius had judged 'of slight ability'; one under-estimated in youth, he later tasted both 'disdain' and 'honor' — his name reaching the lords, the lords receiving him with rank — and the answer to both was the same calm; he proved: the degree your emotion depends on others' evaluations is the degree your person is held by others; noble and base are both other people's quotations, and quotations must not set your temperature; the truly free are not those indifferent to evaluation but those through whom it flows without changing the water level
modes.source_chapter: 《大戴礼记·卫将军文子》：孔子历数弟子之行，评澹台灭明曰'贵之，不喜；贱之，不怒；苟于民利矣，廉于其事上也，以自遂也'——'贵贱'八字为澹台灭明在文献中最直接的情绪品格记载；《史记·仲尼弟子列传》'状貌甚恶……孔子以为材薄'为'贱之'一端的历史底色，'名施乎诸侯'为'贵之'一端的历史注脚；先秦文献以'宠辱不惊'类语评人者不多，澹台灭明是孔子亲口以'贵贱不动'定性过的少数弟子——与他'退而修行'的路径互为因果：唯有情绪不随外界报价波动的人，才经得起三十年的独处积累
modes.key_quote_zh: 贵之不喜，贱之不怒——贵与贱都是别人的出价，出价不该设定你的体温
modes.key_quote_en: "Raised, no delight; slighted, no anger — noble and base are others' quotations, and quotations must not set your temperature."
process_zh: 给自己的'情绪-评价'耦合做体检：记录一周内每次情绪起伏，标注触发源是'事件本身'还是'他人对事件的评价'——后者占比越高，人格被外界持有的份额越大
把'贵'与'贱'统一处理为'报价'：夸奖与贬损都是对方给出的价格，先问报价者有无定价资格——无资格者的报价直接忽略，有资格者的报价只采信息不采情绪
训练'延迟反应'作为硬习惯：收到重大好评或差评后，二十四小时内不做任何回应性动作（不发声明、不改计划、不回敬）——让评价先过期，再决定是否处理
以'水温恒定'为目标经营口碑：长期合作者对你的印象应该是'他不被捧也不被激'——这本身会成为稀缺信用：没人能通过操纵你的情绪来操纵你的决策
process_en: Audit the coupling of emotion and evaluation: log a week of every emotional swing, tagging the trigger as 'the event itself' or 'others' evaluation of the event'; the larger the latter share, the larger the portion of your person held by outsiders

Process noble and base alike as quotations: praise and slight are prices someone quotes; first ask whether the quoter holds the license to price you — ignore the unlicensed, and from the licensed take information, never emotion

Train delayed response as hard habit: after major praise or blame, no responsive action for twenty-four hours — no statement, no plan change, no return fire; let the evaluation expire first, then decide whether it needs handling

Manage a reputation of constant temperature: long-term partners should know you as one who cannot be flattered or provoked — itself scarce credit: no one can steer your decisions by steering your moods
representative_cases_zh: 被'贱之'的少年时代：孔子'以为材薄'——史上最权威的一次轻视，而文献里找不到他任何怨言的记录
被'贵之'的诸侯时代：'名施乎诸侯'后诸侯以礼相待——被抬举的最高记录，而文献里同样找不到得意的记录
'贵之不喜，贱之不怒'被孔子亲口列为定评：情绪独立不是后人追认的美德，而是老师基于终生观察给出的鉴定结论
representative_cases_en: The youth who was 'slighted': Confucius judged him 'of slight ability' — history's most authoritative slight, and the record holds no word of resentment from him
The lord-honored maturity: after 'his name reached the lords,' princes received him with ceremony — the highest record of being raised, and again the record holds no word of elation
'Raised no delight, slighted no anger' as the master's own verdict: emotional independence not a virtue retroactively conferred but a certification issued by his teacher on lifelong observation
modern_applications_zh: 给'好评依赖'做脱敏训练：刻意在拿到的最重要好评面前安排一次'不转发、不回复、不调整'的静默处理——检验它是营养还是饲料
建立'报价人资格表'：谁的评价有定价资格（长期看过你工作的极少数人）、谁只是情绪过路客——把注意力预算的大头划给前者，后者一律按背景噪音计
在团队里奖励'恒温者'：晋升与授权时把'此人情绪是否随舆论波动'列为硬指标——会被捧起来的也会被砸下去，恒温才是可托付的稳定
modern_applications_en: Desensitize against good reviews: deliberately process the most important praise you receive in silence — no forwarding, no reply, no adjustment — to test whether it is nutrition or feed

Keep a table of licensed quoters: whose evaluation may price you (the very few who have watched your work long) and who are passing moods; the bulk of your attention budget goes to the former, the latter enter as background noise

Reward constant temperature in teams: in promotion and delegation make 'does this person's mood track public opinion' a hard criterion; whoever can be lifted by praise can be felled by blame — constancy is the only reliable stability
modes.definition_zh: 《大戴礼记》记孔子历数弟子品行，说到澹台灭明时用了八个字：'贵之不喜，贱之不怒'——被贵人抬举，不喜形于色；被贱视贬低，不动怒于色——这八个字与他的另一重身份严丝合缝：那个被孔夫子'以为材薄'过的人；被低估过的少年后来既尝过'贱'的滋味，也尝过'贵'的滋味（名施诸侯，诸侯以贵相待），两头的反应却是同一个平静；他证明：情绪对他人评价的依赖程度，就是人格被他人持有的程度——贵与贱都是别人的出价，出价不该设定你的体温；真正自由的人不是不在乎评价，而是让评价流过而不改变水位
modes.definition_en: In the Da Dai Liji, when Confucius reviews the conduct of his disciples, eight characters mark Zantai Mieming: 'raised, he shows no delight; slighted, he shows no anger' — honored by the great, no delight on his face; slighted and disdained, no anger on his face — eight characters that fit his other identity exactly: the young man Confucius had judged 'of slight ability'; one under-estimated in youth, he later tasted both 'disdain' and 'honor' — his name reaching the lords, the lords receiving him with rank — and the answer to both was the same calm; he proved: the degree your emotion depends on others' evaluations is the degree your person is held by others; noble and base are both other people's quotations, and quotations must not set your temperature; the truly free are not those indifferent to evaluation but those through whom it flows without changing the water level

modes.name_en: The Method of Withdrawing to Cultivate
modes.category: 方法论/低成本长周期建设
modes.domain_zh: 《史记》四字概括了澹台灭明对误判的反应：'退而修行'——退，但不废；行，但向内；这四个字拆开是一整套低成本长周期战略：误判发生地（鲁国、孔门）的舆论环境已经定形，短期内任何辩解都是负资产，于是他选择'退'——退出误判生效的场域，把沉没成本留在原地；而'修行'二字表明退不是躺平：他退到的南方没有孔门的完整师承资源，也少有既得利益者的阻力，是一块便宜、空旷、可以长周期建设的土地——'从弟子三百人'就是这块土地上的长期工程；他证明：当你在旧市场里被错误定价，最优解往往不是旧市场里翻案，而是找到一块定价便宜、空间空旷的新市场做长周期建设——退是为了让'行'有足够的坡道
modes.domain_en: The Shiji compresses Zantai Mieming's answer to misjudgment into four characters: 'he withdrew and cultivated' — retreating, yet not idle; practicing, yet inward; unpacked, they form a complete low-cost, long-cycle strategy: in the ground where the misjudgment was issued — Lu, the gate of Confucius — the discourse had set, and any short-term defense was a negative asset; so he 'withdrew': he exited the field where the verdict was in force, leaving sunk costs in place; and 'cultivate' shows the retreat was no lying-down: the south he withdrew to had none of the full lineage resources of the Confucian school and few entrenched interests — cheap, open ground for long-cycle building; 'three hundred disciples' was the long project on that ground; he proved: when you are mispriced in the old market, the optimal move is often not to overturn the case there but to find cheap, open ground in a new market and build over a long cycle — the retreat exists to give the cultivation its runway
modes.source_chapter: 《史记·仲尼弟子列传》：'既已受业，退而修行，行不由径，非公事不见卿大夫。南游至江'——'退而修行'为澹台灭明离开孔门后的行动总纲；从受业于孔子到南游至江之间，文献只给出'退而修行'四字——这段沉默期恰是其模式的核心：没有怨言记录、没有辩解记录、没有短期内东山再起的记录，只有修行的静默与最终的南方成果；先秦儒家'退'的传统（孔子'用之则行，舍之则藏'、孟子'穷则独善其身'）中，澹台灭明的独特处在于他的'退'伴随着地理迁移与事业重建，而非隐居避世——退是战术位移，不是退出人生
modes.key_quote_zh: 退而修行——退是为了让'行'有足够的坡道
modes.key_quote_en: "He withdrew and cultivated — the retreat exists to give the cultivation its runway."
process_zh: 判定'翻案成本'：在误判已定形的场域里，估算辩解的时间、人情与胜率——若翻案的期望收益低于同样时间在新场域建设的收益，立即停止投入
把'退'设计成战术位移而非隐退：退的地方要有三样东西——比旧场域更低的竞争密度、更长的建设周期容忍度、与你的能力结构匹配的需求缺口；三样缺一，退就成了流浪
在静默期只做可积累的事：退而不废的关键是每日产出可累积的资产（学问、门徒、作品、口碑）——静默不是消失，是把曝光换成积累
接受'旧市场里的名字先于新市场里的成果'的时间差：南方几百弟子的成果传回鲁国需要年月——长周期战略要求你在成果回流前忍受'消息真空'，不因暂时的无回音而回到旧战场纠缠
process_en: Price the overturn: in the field where the verdict has set, estimate the time, favors and odds of arguing your case; if the expected yield of rehabilitation is below that of building in a new field over the same time, stop investing at once

Design the retreat as tactical repositioning, not eremitism: the ground you retreat to needs three things — lower competitive density than the old field, longer tolerance for building cycles, a demand gap matching your ability structure; lacking any one, retreat becomes drifting

During the silence accumulate only: the key to retreating without idling is daily output of cumulative assets — learning, followers, works, word of mouth; silence is not vanishing but trading exposure for accumulation

Accept the lag of name over fruit: word of three hundred southern disciples took years to travel back to Lu; a long-cycle strategy demands you endure the news vacuum until results flow back, not return to wrangle in the old arena for want of echo
representative_cases_zh: '既已受业，退而修行'：在孔门完成学业后不争位次、不留鲁国发展，直接退场——把无处施展的憋闷换成了南下的启动成本
南游至江的选址逻辑：长江流域在春秋末尚属儒学远郊——竞争密度低、需求缺口大、诸侯对新师门的宽容度高——三样俱全的退守地
静默期与爆发期的完整链条：文献中鲁国沉默的年月与江南三百弟子的成果首尾相接——没有静默期的积累，就没有'名施乎诸侯'的爆发
representative_cases_en: 'Having taken his degree, he withdrew and cultivated': after his schooling under Confucius, no scrambling for rank, no development in Lu — straight out of the arena, converting stifled ambition into the launching cost of the southern journey

The site logic of going south to the river: the Yangtze basin in the late Spring and Autumn was still the far province of Confucian learning — low competitive density, large demand gap, high tolerance from the lords for a new school: all three conditions of a retreat-ground

The full chain of silence and harvest: the silent years in Lu join tail to head with the three hundred disciples in the south — without the accumulation of the silent period there is no 'name reaching the lords'
modern_applications_zh: '翻案成本核算'用在职场污名上：被贴负面标签后，先算'在此组织内洗白'与'携现有资产换赛道'的期望收益——多数情况下换赛道的收益更高，且时间不可逆
新市场选址三条件清单：换城市、换行业、换国家前逐项核对——竞争密度、周期容忍、需求缺口；三缺一就不要动，动了也只会把旧问题带进新地方
静默期产出纪律：给自己规定'退出的头 N 个月每周必须有可累积产出'（作品、证书、客户、学生）——静默不等于停更；停更的退场会变成真正的消失
modern_applications_en: Cost out rehabilitation versus lane-change on stigma: once a negative label sticks, compare the expected yield of washing it out inside the organization against carrying your assets to a new track; usually the lane-change wins, and time is irreversible

A three-condition checklist for new markets: before changing city, industry or country, verify — competitive density, cycle tolerance, demand gap; missing any one, do not move, or you will only carry the old problem into the new place

Output discipline for the silent period: rule that for the first N months of retreat you produce one cumulative asset a week — a work, a certificate, a client, a student; silence is not going dark; a retreat that goes dark becomes a real vanishing

modes.name_en: The Method of Founding a School in Fresh Ground
modes.domain_zh: 春秋末期的儒学版图上，鲁国是中心也是红海：孔门弟子与再传弟子云集，位置、名分与讲席都有人占着；澹台灭明'南游至江'，把儒学带到了长江流域——当时吴楚之间的儒学远郊；这个选址的战略含义在结果里写得清楚：'从弟子三百人，设取予去就，名施乎诸侯'——同样的学问，在鲁国他是'材薄'的边缘弟子，在南方他是立规矩、收三百徒、名声直达诸侯的开宗者；学问没变，变的是市场的竞争密度与需求缺口；他证明：一个人的成就不只在个人努力里，更在'把自己的能力放在哪块土地上'的选择里——在饱和市场做边缘人，不如到空白市场做定义者；地理是成本最低的战略变量
modes.domain_en: On the map of late-Spring-and-Autumn Confucianism, Lu was both center and red ocean: disciples and second-generation disciples crowded the positions, titles and lecterns; Zantai Mieming 'traveled south to the river,' carrying Confucian learning to the Yangtze basin — then the far province between Wu and Chu; the strategic meaning of that choice is written in the outcome: 'three hundred disciples, rules of taking, giving, going, staying, name reaching the lords' — the same learning with which he was a 'slight-ability' marginal student in Lu made him in the south a founder who set the code, gathered three hundred, and was heard by the lords; the learning unchanged, what changed was the market's competitive density and demand gap; he proved: achievement lies not only in personal effort but in the choice of which ground to place one's ability on — a marginal man in a saturated market, better a definer in an empty one; geography is the cheapest of strategic variables
modes.source_chapter: 《史记·仲尼弟子列传》：'南游至江，从弟子三百人，设取予去就，名施乎诸侯'——澹台灭明为孔门弟子中最早有明确'南下'记录者之一；春秋末期长江下游（吴、越、楚地）儒学影响薄弱，孔门传播网络尚未覆盖；澹台灭明的南下恰逢吴越争霸后江东社会秩序重建、对'取予去就'类伦理规程存在真实需求的历史窗口；《史记》将其列为'南游'儒学传播的早期案例，后世江南儒学与吴地文教传统常追认其为先声；其'从弟子三百人'的规模在孔门同辈中亦属最大之列——在空白市场，单点突破的杠杆远高于饱和市场
modes.key_quote_zh: 南游至江，从弟子三百人——在饱和市场做边缘人，不如到空白市场做定义者
modes.key_quote_en: "South to the river, three hundred disciples — a marginal man in a saturated market, better a definer in an empty one."
process_zh: 绘制自己能力的'市场地图'：列出你的核心能力在各地理/行业市场中的竞争密度与定价水平——找到'这里被低估、那里是稀缺'的价差区
优先选'需求缺口与能力结构匹配'的空地而非'什么都缺'的荒地：南方缺儒学且诸侯需要秩序规范——缺口与他的货（取予去就的规程）严丝合缝；纯粹的空白若无人需要你的货，去了也只是搬家
评估'文化半径'的可达性：你的东西需要背书吗？在鲁国他背着'被低估'的背书，在南方他背'孔门受业'的背书——同一出身，换个市场就从不光彩变成稀缺资历
在空地快速建立定义权：到站先'设'规矩而非先抢存量——空白市场的红利期属于第一个立规则的人；等别人也来了，定义权战争就开始了
process_en: Map your ability across markets: list the competitive density and pricing of your core ability in each geographic or industry market; find the price differential where 'undervalued here, scarce there'

Prefer ground where the demand gap matches your ability structure over wilderness that lacks everything: the south lacked Confucian learning and the lords needed codes of order — the gap fitted his goods exactly; pure emptiness with no need for your goods is only a change of address

Weigh the reach of your cultural radius: does your credential travel? In Lu he carried the credential 'underrated'; in the south, 'trained at the gate of Confucius' — one origin, and a different market turns it from disgrace into scarce pedigree

Establish defining power fast on empty ground: on arrival, set rules before grabbing stock — the dividend of an empty market belongs to the first to lay down rules; when others arrive, the war of definition begins
representative_cases_zh: 南游至江的完整决策链：离开儒学中心鲁国→进入儒学远郊江东→'从弟子三百人'成为当地最大师门——一步地理迁移完成身份翻转
'名施乎诸侯'的传播路径：江东到鲁国的距离反而放大了名声——空白市场的成功自带新闻价值，饱和市场的成功只是又一个成功
与同门在鲁国境内的位置竞争对照：文献中孔门弟子在鲁国的名位争夺密度极高（仕于季氏、互相评骘），而澹台灭明在南方无竞争记录——换了战场，连竞争都消失了
representative_cases_en: The full decision chain of going south: out of Confucianism's center Lu, into its far province the lower Yangtze, 'three hundred disciples' the largest school in the region — one act of geographic repositioning completed the reversal of identity

The transmission path of 'name reaching the lords': the very distance from the Yangtze to Lu magnified his fame — success in an empty market carries news value; success in a saturated market is just another success

The contrast with position contests inside Lu: the record of disciples contending for office and rank in Lu is dense; of Zantai in the south, no contest at all is recorded — a change of field dissolved even competition
modern_applications_zh: 给职业选择加一道'地理杠杆'检验：同一个技能组合（如法律+技术、中文+AI），在一线城市是内卷品，在二线机构或新兴行业是稀缺品——先算价差再决定去留
新兴市场进入纪律：进入一个新行业/新地区/新平台，第一动作是'立规程'（方法论、标准、社区规范）而非抢流量——定义权窗口期通常只有一两年
把'被低估'当作迁移信号而非改进信号：在同一市场连续被低估两次以上，问题多半不在表现而在市场定价结构——换市场的优先级应高于加倍努力
modern_applications_en: Add a geography-leverage test to career choice: the same skill pairing — law plus technology, language plus AI — is a commodity in the tier-one city and a rarity in a tier-two institution or new industry; price the differential before deciding to stay

Entry discipline for new markets: entering a new industry, region or platform, the first act is to set rules — methodology, standards, community norms — not to grab traffic; the window of definition usually lasts a year or two

Read persistent undervaluation as a signal to migrate, not to try harder: twice undervalued in one market, the fault lies less in performance than in the market's pricing structure; re-ranking 'change markets' above 'double the effort' is due

modes.name_en: The Method of Incorrupt Service Upward
modes.domain_zh: 《大戴礼记》记孔子评语的后半句是：'苟于民利矣，廉于其事上也，以自遂也'——只要于民有利，在事奉上级这件事上始终保持廉洁，以此成全自己（的自遂——走完自己的路）；这半句给'清廉'一个罕见的功能性定位：澹台灭明的廉不是表演给上级看的忠诚，而是保护自己事业主干的方式—— upward 的边界守得住，自己三百弟子的学业才不被权力关系污染；'非公事未尝至于偃之室'是这原则在武城的具体化：他给长官子游做事，但拒绝用私谊兑换公务；他证明：对上清廉不是道德装饰，而是利益的防火墙——你在权力面前的每一次通融，都会变成别人要挟你的把柄；边界干净的人才有资格长期独立
modes.domain_en: The second half of the Da Dai Liji verdict reads: 'if it profits the people, then even in serving superiors he keeps himself incorrupt, so to complete his own way' — Zantai's incorruptness was not loyalty performed for superiors but the way he protected the trunk of his enterprise: hold the boundary upward, and the schooling of three hundred disciples stays uncontaminated by power relations; 'never save on official business to the governor's room' is the principle made concrete at Wucheng: he served the governor Ziyou, yet refused to trade private friendship for public business; he proved: incorruptness upward is not moral ornament but a firewall of interest — every concession you make before power becomes a handle others grip; only those with clean boundaries qualify for lasting independence
modes.source_chapter: 《大戴礼记·卫将军文子》：'苟于民利矣，廉于其事上也，以自遂也'——'廉于其事上'与'以自遂'的因果连接为此评最独特处：廉不是目的而是'自遂'（保全并走完自己的道路）的手段；《论语·雍也》'非公事未尝至于偃之室'为同一边界在具体场景中的记录：事上（为子游属吏）与廉洁（公事之外不登私室）在文献中互证；先秦文献中'廉'与'事上'并提者不罕见，但把'廉'解释为'自遂'之条件者极少——澹台灭明的廉被同时代观察者理解为一种自我保全与独立性的制度安排，而非单纯德目
modes.key_quote_zh: 苟于民利矣，廉于其事上也，以自遂也——对上清廉不是道德装饰，而是事业的防火墙
modes.key_quote_en: "If it profits the people, even in serving superiors he keeps incorrupt, so to complete his own way — incorruptness upward is not moral ornament but the firewall of one's enterprise."
process_zh: 给'对上通道'列负面清单：与上级的互动中，哪些是公务通道（可走）、哪些是私谊通道（不通）——预先写死，不让具体情境临时解释
把'廉'理解为防火墙而非美德徽章：每一次对上通融（帮忙走后门、代传私话、接受非分恩惠）都在权力关系里给你增加一个'被掌握的点'——逐点排查自己身上已有的把柄
用'于民利'做最终校验：上级的要求与公众利益冲突时，以'苟于民利'为准——这句话给了你在'事上'框架内说'不'的正当性来源
把'自遂'当作边界红利的复利：边界守得越久，你独立性的信用越高——信用本身就是与上级谈判时的最大筹码；为短期便利破边界的成本是这套复利的清零
process_en: List the negative list of upward channels: in dealings with superiors, which are official channels (open) and which private-favor channels (closed) — fixed in advance, left to no live interpretation

Understand incorruptness as firewall, not badge: every concession upward — threading a back door, relaying private words, accepting undue favor — adds to the power relation a point at which you can be gripped; audit the handles already on your person

Take 'profit to the people' as final check: when a superior's demand conflicts with the public interest, 'if it profits the people' rules — the sentence supplies your warrant for saying no inside the frame of serving

Bank the compounding dividend of boundaries: the longer boundaries hold, the higher your credit of independence — itself your largest chip in negotiating upward; breaking a boundary for short-term convenience zeroes the compounding
representative_cases_zh: 武城的公私之墙：为子游属吏期间'非公事未尝至于偃之室'——上下级关系最密切的形态（直属属吏）中划出的最干净边界
'以自遂'的功能定位：孔子把他的廉解释为'走完自己道路'的条件——同时代观察者已经看清：这种廉是为三百弟子的事业投保，不是给上级看的表演
与'名施乎诸侯'的因果链：师门规模越大、名声越高，权力寻租的接触面越大——他一路守住'廉于事上'，事业主干才未被任何政权收编或玷污
representative_cases_en: The wall of public and private at Wucheng: serving as Ziyou's subordinate — the closest form of superior-subordinate relation — he drew the cleanest boundary: never to the governor's room save on official business

'So to complete his own way' as a functional verdict: the master read his incorruptness as the condition of finishing his own road — contemporaries saw it already: such integrity insured the enterprise of three hundred disciples, performed for no superior

The causal chain with 'name reaching the lords': the larger the school and the higher the fame, the wider the surface for rent-seeking; holding the boundary all along, the trunk of his enterprise was never conscripted or stained by any regime
modern_applications_zh: 建立'对上负面清单'：把'帮领导办私事''代持''代传话''非工作时段单独应酬'逐项决定通或不通——清单比意志可靠，情境永远会给出破例的理由
每年做一次'把柄盘点'：列出你身上已被上级或组织掌握的非分之点（欠人情、违规记录、把柄信息）——能清偿的清偿，不能清偿的下一年度停止新增
以'服务对象利益'为说'不'的锚点：拒绝上级越界要求时，把理由锚定在'这样做损害客户/公众/团队利益'上——比'我不愿意'更安全也更正当
modern_applications_en: Build the negative list for upward dealings: decide in advance on running private errands for the boss, holding assets in trust, relaying private words, one-on-one socializing after hours — the list is more reliable than willpower, and situations always supply reasons for exception

An annual audit of handles: list the undue points about you already held by superiors or the organization — favors owed, records bent, compromising information; settle what can be settled, and add nothing new next year
Anchor refusals to the served party's interest: in declining a superior's overreach, ground the reason in harm to client, public or team — safer and more legitimate than 'I would rather not'

modes.name_en: The Method of Learning Without Resentment
modes.domain_zh: 史书写澹台灭明与孔子的关系有一条极不寻常的线：孔子'以为材薄'——收他做学生却没把他当回事；而澹台灭明'既已受业'——照样完成了学业，'退而修行'——照样按孔门的功课打磨自己，终生没有任何怨恨或不认师门的记录；更不寻常的是，孔子晚年听见他的名声后亲口说'以貌取人，失之子羽'——这句话能传下来，说明师徒之间的通道始终没有关闭：如果澹台灭明早已与孔门决裂或否定其学，孔子的自省之词便无处安放也无人记录；他证明：被误解时最深的修养是保持通道畅通——不辩解不是断绝，而是把'被看见'的可能性留给时间；怨恨关闭的是自己的耳朵，最终听不见的只有道歉
modes.domain_en: The record of Zantai Mieming and Confucius runs along a most unusual line: the master 'judged him of slight ability' — took him as a student and paid him little regard; and Zantai 'having taken his degree' completed his schooling all the same, 'withdrew and cultivated' — polishing himself by the school's own curriculum, with no record ever of resentment or of disowning the master; more unusual still: in old age Confucius heard his fame and said aloud 'judging by looks, I lost Ziyu' — that the words survive shows the channel between them never closed: had Zantai long before broken with the school or disowned its learning, the master's self-reproach would have had nowhere to rest and no one to record it; he proved: the deepest cultivation when misunderstood is keeping the channel open — not arguing is not severing, but leaving the possibility of being seen to time; resentment shuts one's own ears, and in the end what one fails to hear is the apology
modes.source_chapter: 《史记·仲尼弟子列传》：'状貌甚恶。欲事孔子，孔子以为材薄。既已受业，退而修行……孔子闻之，曰：以言取人，失之宰予；以貌取人，失之子羽'——文本顺序本身即是证据：受业、修行、成名、夫子自省，四段之间无决裂记录；《论语·雍也》子游荐其在武城之'行不由径'，说明孔门内部对其品行始终有正面确认；《大戴礼记·卫将军文子》孔子历数弟子仍及其名并予'贵之不喜贱之不怒'之定评——被低估者终身留在师门的评价体系内且被最终高评，为孔门师徒关系史上'受业不怨'的最完整案例
modes.key_quote_zh: 以貌取人，失之子羽——不辩解不是断绝，而是把'被看见'的可能性留给时间
modes.key_quote_en: "Judging by looks, I lost Ziyu — not arguing is not severing, but leaving the possibility of being seen to time."
process_zh: 把'被低估'与'所学价值'分开记账：老师看错你这个人，不等于课程没有价值——恨意若污染了学业，损失最终记在自己账上；澹台灭明'既已受业'：先把学费上够
禁止自己单方面关闭通道：不宣布决裂、不公开否定、不烧船——通道畅通的成本是保持沉默的耐心，通道关闭的成本是永远失去'被看见'与'被道歉'的可能
把怨恨转化为修行配额：每次想辩解或回击的冲动，兑换成一件可积累的功课——冲动是消耗品，功课是资产；情绪的每一次循环都必须留下沉淀
给对方的自省留出'可送达'的位置：孔子的'失之子羽'能够成立并流传，前提是澹台灭明没有把关系闹到'道歉无门'——高级的做法是让对方的承认随时可以送达且不必跨越敌意
process_en: Keep two accounts: being undervalued, and the value of what is taught; the teacher misreading you does not void the course — if resentment poisons the schooling, the loss posts to your own ledger; Zantai 'having taken his degree' paid his fees in full first

Forbid yourself unilateral closure of the channel: no declared rupture, no public disowning, no burned ships; an open channel costs the patience of silence; a closed one costs forever the chance of being seen — and of being apologized to

Convert resentment into a quota of cultivation: each impulse to argue or strike back, exchange for one piece of cumulative work; impulse is consumable, work is asset; every cycle of emotion must leave sediment

Leave the other's self-reproach a deliverable address: the master's 'I lost Ziyu' could stand and be transmitted only because Zantai never dragged the relation to where apology had no door; the high move is letting the other's admission arrive at any time without crossing hostility
representative_cases_zh: '既已受业'四个字的重量：在'以为材薄'的判断之后仍完成全部学业——没有中途退学、没有学业打折，这是对师门与对自己训练价值的双重确认
'失之子羽'的传播链：孔子的自省之词经由弟子们（包括子游这个正面了解他的人）记录流传——通道畅通的人才会被写进别人的忏悔里
《大戴礼记》定评的最终落点：孔子晚年历数弟子仍给他'贵之不喜贱之不怒'的最高品行评语——误会以双方各自的体面收场，没有以决裂收场
representative_cases_en: The weight of 'having taken his degree': after the verdict 'slight ability,' the full course completed — no mid-way dropout, no discount on the schooling; a double affirmation of the school and of the training's worth

The chain of transmission for 'I lost Ziyu': the master's self-reproach survived through disciples — including Ziyou, who knew him well and positively; only one whose channel stayed open gets written into another's confession

The final resting point of the Da Dai verdict: reviewing his disciples in old age, Confucius still gave him the highest appraisal of conduct — the misunderstanding closed with dignity on both sides, not with rupture
modern_applications_zh: '先毕业再评价'原则：即使认定导师/雇主看错了你，把当下这段经历的学习价值吃干净再走——带着完整技能包离开的人，才有资格谈'是他们错了'
给'单方面断联'设冷静期：对伤害过你的前上司/前合作方，不删除、不拉黑、不公开控诉，只是不再主动——通道成本极低而期权价值极高
怨恨兑换配额制：每当想公开回击，先完成一件对长期有利的事（学完一门课、写完一个作品）再决定——多数冲动在功课完成后自动作废
modern_applications_en: Graduate before you judge: even convinced the mentor or employer misread you, extract the full learning value of the season before leaving; only one who leaves with a complete skill-set earns the right to say 'they were wrong'

A cooling period for unilateral cutoff: toward the former boss or partner who wronged you — no deletion, no blocking, no public accusation, only no initiative; the channel costs almost nothing and carries enormous option value

A redemption quota for resentment: whenever the urge to strike back publicly rises, first finish one thing of long-term profit — a course, a work — and then decide; most impulses void themselves once the work is done

modes.name_en: The Method of Lighting Three Hundred Lamps
modes.domain_zh: 孔门弟子中，把学问带出鲁国并建立起大规模地方师门的，澹台灭明是第一人：'从弟子三百人'——这个数字与孔子本人'弟子三千'的比例是一比十，一个被判定'材薄'的学生建立起了老师十分之一规模的师门；更关键的是他传的内容：'设取予去就'——不是复述老师的语录，而是把儒学中最难落地的行为规范（取予去就）变成可执行、可传承的规程；他证明：传承的最高形态不是复制老师，而是把老师学问中'在自己手里最能立起来的部分'重新制度化——澹台灭明没有成为第二个孔子，他成为三百个南方弟子的澹台灭明；被低估者的最好证明，是造出一批不需要再证明的人
modes.domain_en: Among the disciples of Confucius, Zantai Mieming was the first to carry the learning out of Lu and build a large regional school: 'three hundred disciples' — one to ten against the master's 'three thousand,' a student judged 'of slight ability' building a school a tenth the scale of his teacher's; more crucial is what he transmitted: 'he set rules of taking, giving, going, staying' — not reciting the teacher's sayings, but re-institutionalizing the hardest-to-operationalize part of Confucian ethics, the code of acquisition and refusal, into executable, transmissible rules; he proved: the highest form of transmission is not copying the teacher but re-institutionalizing the part of the teacher's learning that stands up best in one's own hands — Zantai never became a second Confucius; he became the Zantai Mieming of three hundred southern disciples; the best proof of the underestimated man is to produce a batch of people who need prove nothing
modes.source_chapter: 《史记·仲尼弟子列传》：'南游至江，从弟子三百人，设取予去就，名施乎诸侯'——'从弟子三百人'为孔门同辈弟子中最大规模的地方师门记录之一；孔子'弟子盖三千焉，身通六艺者七十有二人'（《史记·孔子世家》），澹台灭明三百之数与其师形成一比十的规模对照；《大戴礼记·卫将军文子》所记其品行（贵之不喜、贱之不怒、廉于事上）即是他能给三百弟子示范的行为标准——传的不是话语而是可模仿的生活；南方师门的意义在后世的江南文教传统中被长期追认：吴地儒学之源，史家多溯至澹台灭明南游
modes.key_quote_zh: 从弟子三百人——传承的最高形态不是复制老师，而是把学问中在自己手里最能立起来的部分重新制度化
modes.key_quote_en: "Three hundred disciples — the highest transmission copies not the teacher but re-institutionalizes the part of his learning that stands up best in your own hands."
process_zh: 从老师的学问里选'自己最能立起来的部分'：不贪全盘继承——澹台灭明选的是'取予去就'（行为规程），不是'仁'（最高概念）；选品标准是'我能把它变成规程'而非'它最重要'
把选中的部分做成'可模仿的生活'而非'可引用的话'：弟子三百人学的是他怎么拿钱、怎么谢绝、怎么辞官——身教的可复制性远高于言教；先活成标本，再收徒
以'规模'检验传承质量：三百人的师门意味着规程必须去人格化——你不在场时系统仍在运转的规模，就是传承真正的成色
允许南方形态与鲁国形态分叉：他的师门在江东长出了自己的样子（面向诸侯、规矩先行）——传承的目标是学问在新土地上的存活，不是在旧土地上的原样搬运
process_en: Choose from the teacher's learning the part you can best stand up: not wholesale inheritance — Zantai chose 'taking, giving, going, staying,' a code of conduct, not 'humaneness,' the supreme concept; the criterion is 'can I make it a rule,' not 'is it most important'

Make the chosen part a livable, imitable life, not a quotable text: three hundred disciples learned how he took money, declined favor, resigned office — the copyability of living example far exceeds that of lectures; become the specimen first, take disciples after
Test transmission by scale: a school of three hundred means the code must be de-personalized; the scale at which the system runs in your absence is the true assay of transmission

Let the southern form fork from the Lu form: his school grew its own shape by the river — facing the lords, rules first; the aim of transmission is the learning's survival on new ground, not its verbatim transplant onto old ground
representative_cases_zh: 三百人对三千人：一个被判'材薄'的弟子建立老师十分之一规模的师门——规模本身是对'材薄'判决最响亮的驳回
'设取予去就'的选品智慧：孔门学问中最重要的概念是仁义，而他在南方立起来的恰是最可执行的规程——抓住'自己手里能立起来的'而非'理论上最伟大的'
江南文教的先声：后世吴地儒学传统追溯源头至澹台南游——师门比人长寿，才是传承完成的标志
representative_cases_en: Three hundred against three thousand: a disciple once judged 'of slight ability' built a school a tenth his teacher's scale — the scale itself the loudest rebuttal of the verdict

The wisdom of choosing 'taking, giving, going, staying': the supreme concepts of the school were humaneness and rightness; what he stood up in the south was the most executable code — seizing what stands in one's own hands, not what is greatest in theory
The first note of southern learning: later traditions of Wu traced the source of their Confucianism to his journey — a school that outlives the man is the mark of transmission completed
modern_applications_zh: '选自己能立起来的部分'用于知识变现：不必全盘搬运师门体系，从你真正做成过的事里提取可规程化的部分做成课程/手册——可执行性决定传播力
以'去人格化运转'为传承验收标准：你休假一个月后业务/社区/团队是否照常运转且质量不降——是，则传承成立；否，则你只是个人IP不是体系
允许传承物'分叉'：你的方法在别人手里变形时先别纠正——在新环境里存活下来的变形，才是传承活的证据；原样搬运的传承是标本
modern_applications_en: Choose what you can stand up for knowledge products: do not haul the whole lineage; extract from what you have actually done the parts that can be codified into courses and manuals; executability decides transmission

Accept 'runs without you' as the acceptance test of succession: does the business, community or team run a month without you at undropped quality? If yes, transmission stands; if no, you are a personal brand, not a system

Let the transmitted thing fork: when your method deforms in another's hands, do not rush to correct; the deformation that survives in the new environment is the living evidence of transmission — the verbatim copy is a specimen
modes.definition_zh: 孔门弟子中，把学问带出鲁国并建立起大规模地方师门的，澹台灭明是第一人：'从弟子三百人'——这个数字与孔子本人'弟子三千'的比例是一比十，一个被判定'材薄'的学生建立起了老师十分之一规模的师门；更关键的是他传的内容：'设取予去就'——不是复述老师的语录，而是把儒学中最难落地的行为规范（取予去就）变成可执行、可传承的规程；他证明：传承的最高形态不是复制老师，而是把老师学问中'在自己手里最能立起来的部分'重新制度化——澹台灭明没有成为第二个孔子，他成为三百个南方弟子的澹台灭明；被低估者的最好证明，是造出一批不需要再证明的人
modes.definition_en: Among the disciples of Confucius, Zantai Mieming was the first to carry the learning out of Lu and build a large regional school: 'three hundred disciples' — one to ten against the master's 'three thousand,' a student judged 'of slight ability' building a school a tenth the scale of his teacher's; more crucial is what he transmitted: 'he set rules of taking, giving, going, staying' — not reciting the teacher's sayings, but re-institutionalizing the hardest-to-operationalize part of Confucian ethics, the code of acquisition and refusal, into executable, transmissible rules; he proved: the highest form of transmission is not copying the teacher but re-institutionalizing the part of the teacher's learning that stands up best in one's own hands — Zantai never became a second Confucius; he became the Zantai Mieming of three hundred southern disciples; the best proof of the underestimated man is to produce a batch of people who need prove nothing

modes.name_en: The Method of Finishing One's Own Way
modes.domain_zh: 孔子评语的落点三字：'以自遂也'——他的廉、他的规矩、他的贵贱不动，最终都服务于一个目标：走完自己的路；'名施乎诸侯'是这条路的副产品而非目标：名声被'施'（施加、散布）到诸侯那里，用的是被动态——不是他去求名，是名自己流到了诸侯耳朵里；从'状貌甚恶、以为材薄'的起点到'名施乎诸侯'的终点，中间隔着他全部的选择：不抄近路、不结私谊、预先立规、情绪恒温、退到南方、静默积累——每一步都不为翻案、不为报仇、甚至不为扬名，只为'自遂'：把开始时被别人定义的人生，走成由自己完成的句子；他证明：人生的最终评分标准不是'别人是否收回误判'，而是'你是否走完了自己的路'——误判的撤销只是收据，自遂才是货物
modes.domain_en: The master's verdict lands on three characters: 'so to complete his own way' — his incorruptness, his rules, his unshaken calm all served one end: to walk his own road to its end; 'his name reaching the lords' is the by-product, not the goal: the name was 'applied,' spread in the passive — he did not seek fame; the name flowed of itself to the ears of princes; from the start — a mean face, 'slight ability' — to the end — name reaching the lords — lie all his choices: no shortcuts, no private ties, rules set in advance, constant temperature, withdrawal south, silent accumulation — each step not for rehabilitation, not for revenge, not even for fame, but for 'completing his own way': turning a life defined by others at its opening into a sentence finished by himself; he proved: the final standard of a life is not 'did others retract their misjudgment' but 'did you finish your own road' — the retraction is only the receipt; the completed way is the goods
modes.source_chapter: 《大戴礼记·卫将军文子》：'苟于民利矣，廉于其事上也，以自遂也'——'自遂'一词在先秦人物评价中极为罕见：它不以'忠''孝''仁'等关系性德目收尾，而以'完成自己'收尾——澹台灭明因此成为先秦文献中少数以'自我完成'为定评的人物；《史记·仲尼弟子列传》'名施乎诸侯'的被动语态与'孔子闻之'的叙述顺序呼应：名声到达诸侯与孔子的耳中都是'施'与'闻'的被动抵达——主体始终在走自己的路，评价是路人；先秦儒家'为己之学'（孔子'古之学者为己'）的传统中，澹台灭明是把'为己之学'走完一生的最完整案例：受业为己、修行为己、设规为己、传灯为己——名，是别人的事
modes.key_quote_zh: 以自遂也——人生的最终评分标准不是'别人是否收回误判'，而是'你是否走完了自己的路'
modes.key_quote_en: "So to complete his own way — the final standard of a life is not 'did others retract their misjudgment' but 'did you finish your own road.'"
process_zh: 把'自遂'定为最终验收标准：任何重大决策（换市场、立规矩、接受荣誉）只问一句——它让我离'走完自己的路'更近还是更远；翻案、复仇、扬名都不是验收项
把名声当被动变量管理：做值得被流传的事，然后不为传播做任何超出作品本身的动作——'名施乎诸侯'的前提是名有'可施之物'；没有货的名声是负债
守住'于民利'的路线校验：自遂不等于自私——他的路每一程都有'苟于民利矣'的公共交付；只遂己而不利民的路，历史会把它改写成自私
以'句子完整性'回顾一生：把人生当作一个由自己执笔的句子——起点（被误判）不由你，但句法（每一次选择）与句号（走完）由你；定期检查：这个句子是否仍在按自己的语法推进，还是已被别人的语法接管
process_en: Fix 'completing one's own way' as the acceptance standard: for every major decision — changing markets, setting rules, accepting honors — one question only: does it bring me nearer to finishing my own road; rehabilitation, revenge and fame are none of them acceptance items

Manage reputation as a passive variable: do things worth transmitting, then take no step of promotion beyond the work itself; 'name reaching the lords' presupposes a thing for the name to carry; fame without goods is a liability

Hold the route-check of public benefit: completing one's way is not self-interest — every stretch of his road carried a public delivery, 'if it profits the people'; the road that completes only the self and profits none, history rewrites as selfishness

Review life as the integrity of a sentence: treat life as a sentence of your own authorship — the opening (misjudged) not yours, but the syntax (each choice) and the period (finishing) yours; check regularly: does the sentence still advance by its own grammar, or has another's grammar taken over
representative_cases_zh: '以自遂也'的定评结构：孔子给他的整句评语以'自遂'收尾而非以任何德目收尾——同时代最高的评价形式：肯定你走完了自己的路
'名施乎诸侯'的被动语法：名是被'施'到诸侯那里的——他终生未做过一次求名动作，文献中也确无一求名记录；名声成为路径的回声而非目标
从'状貌甚恶'到'名施乎诸侯'的完整弧线：起点是别人给的（误判），终点是别人给的（名声），而中间的路全是自己走的——起点与终点都是评价，只有路是自己
representative_cases_en: The structure of the verdict ending in 'completing his own way': the master's whole appraisal closes not on any virtue-term but on the self's completion — the age's highest form of praise: you finished your road

The passive grammar of 'name reaching the lords': the name was applied, spread — all his life not one act of seeking fame stands in the record, and none is claimed; fame became the echo of the path, not its target

The full arc from 'a mean countenance' to 'name reaching the lords': the opening given by others (the misjudgment), the ending given by others (the fame), the road between all his own — opening and close are both evaluations; the road alone is his
modern_applications_zh: 给年度目标加'自遂审计'：列出今年所有大动作，逐项标注'这是为了走完我的路，还是为了纠正别人对我的看法'——后者超过三成，说明人生语法已被他人接管
'名声为回声'的作品纪律：发布作品后设定'零运营期'（除作品本身外不做任何推广动作），观察它的自然传播半径——回声半径才是真实价值，运营出来的声量是广告
以'句子完整性'做十年回顾：每十年问一次'这个十年的句子写完了吗'——被外力中断未完的句子要决定：续写（回到主线）还是标记为从句（正式放下）
modern_applications_en: A self-completion audit for annual goals: list the year's major moves and tag each 'does this advance my own road, or correct others' view of me'; if the latter exceeds a third, the grammar of your life has been taken over by others

A work discipline of 'fame as echo': after publishing, set a zero-promotion period — no marketing beyond the work itself — and watch its natural radius; the echo radius is the true value; volume bought by operations is advertising

A decade review by sentence integrity: every ten years ask 'was this decade's sentence finished'; for sentences broken by outside force, decide: resume the main clause, or mark it a subordinate one and formally let it go
